category_title: Preschoolers with disruptive behaviors maintained by attention and escape
scenario_title: Disruptive behavior during preschool circle time
minimal_context: Delon is participating in a preschool circle time activity where the teacher is reading a book and asking students questions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, let's sit in our circle. I am going to open our circle time book and begin to read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes an animal noise and starts shouting) I can’t see the book!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit still and be quiet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shouts) This is boring! (Hums a song and pretends to touch the peer sitting in front of him)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's keep reading. Now, I am going to ask another student a question. Sarah, what do you think happens next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Touches the peer sitting next to him, then hits the peer)

dialogue_combined:

task.content: Participating in circle time activities, such as listening to a book being read or other students answering questions

context.materials: Circle time book, pictures and words defining classroom expectations posted
context.social_setting: Seated within a group of boys who played with him and encouraged his disruptive behavior
